data.description:
The data to render. This may be any instance and will be displayed using some appropriate UI depending on its
type.

asTree.description: Ignore any special renderings and display the value as a JSON tree using {@link DataTree}.

action.description: Get the data to visualize by calling the specified action.

title:
The console generic data visualization. This instantiates the console tab labeled "Visualizer" (with the eye icon).
It also creates the global function `c3Viz` that can be invoked with any object in JavaScript.
name: ConsoleVisualize
